title: Members on Several Therapies — Specialty Pharmacy Program Terms
content:
### Terms for members with more than one specialty enrollment

1. **Separate records per therapy.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, each of a member's specialty enrollments keeps its own fills, its own assistance and its own balance. Assistance from one drug's manufacturer program never pays a fill of another drug.
2. **One combined credit limit.** The specialty credit limit of the member's tier applies to the sum of the balance due across all of the member's open specialty enrollments. A balance on one therapy can therefore hold shipments of another. The member is over the limit when that combined balance due exceeds the specialty credit limit.
3. **Combined deliveries.** When deliveries for several therapies fall due within the same window of refill-scheduling lead business days, they are combined into one shipment on the earliest needed date. Each fill is still booked to its own enrollment.
4. **One deductible and one out-of-pocket.** Cost share from every enrollment counts toward the member's single plan deductible and single out-of-pocket.

### The combined limit worked through (assumed figures)

Assume a tier with a specialty credit limit of $250.00.

| Balance due on therapy A | Balance due on therapy B | Combined balance due | Exceeds $250.00? |
|---|---|---|---|
| $180.00 | $100.00 | $280.00 | Yes. Shipments of either therapy can be held. |
| $150.00 | $100.00 | $250.00 | No. It equals the limit and does not exceed it. |
| $0.00 | $260.00 | $260.00 | Yes. The balance on therapy B alone takes the combined figure over the limit, so it can hold shipments of therapy A. |

### Questions on these terms

- *Can a copay card for one drug pay a balance on another therapy?* No. Assistance from one drug's manufacturer program never pays another drug's fill.
- *When two therapies ship together, whose enrollment carries each fill?* Each fill is booked to its own enrollment, even though the shipment is combined.
